name: Hardwood Sealer vs Finish: What's the Difference
title-tag: Hardwood Sealer vs Finish: What's the Difference?
meta-description: Sealer is the first coat and sets color and adhesion; finish is the wear layer. What each does, when a sealer is skippable, and how to check your quote.
post-summary: March 1, 2027 · The sealer is the first coat and controls absorption, bleed, and color; the finish is the wear layer that takes the abuse. What each layer does, the four different things called “sealer,” and the questions that reveal whether your quote includes a real system.
